text:
alana: Quick heads-up — planning a gentle routing-policy shift for APAC edge to steer 10% traffic to the v2 kv-cache-friendly path tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Asking for owners, smoke cadence, and rollback ready checks.

mike: I can own the handoff and be primary on-call during the window. timeline ok for me.

jasper: I’ll run the preflight smoke scripts and watch tail metrics. what’s the planned rollout increments?

alana: plan: 09:00 -> 10%, 09:20 -> 30%, 09:50 -> 60%, 10:20 -> 100% if all green. 5m observation between steps.

tori: tagging infra: we need to ensure routed pools have warmed caches. I’ll do a warmup job 08:30 UTC.

lucy: can we add a short synthetic that exercises long-context kv lookups? would catch regressions.

jasper: yes, I have a quick synthetic. command:```bash
# run 200 synthetic reqs with kv-heavy prompt
scripts/run_synth.sh --region apac --profile kv-heavy --count 200
```

mike: smoke checklist (short):
• run synth (jasper)
• confirm <50ms tail p50 token latency on canary nodes
• check error-rate <0.5%
• validate cost-per-token within expected band
• verify canary logs show no unknown warnings

alana: rollback plan: policy flipback command below, immediate rollback if error-rate >1% or latency regress >40% sustained 2 minutes.

alana: rollback command:```json
{"route_policy":"apac-edge","weight_shift":"-10%","target":"v2","apply_mode":"immediate"}
```

mike: deploy-bot will post updates. @jasper please post synth results into this thread with timing. I’ll execute the weight changes via ops runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled change queued by mike for 2025-10-03T09:00:00Z. Runbook: /ops/runbooks/apac-soft-shift.md :eyes:

jasper: synth done 08:45 UTC -> 200 reqs, 0.3% errors, p50 token latency 38ms, p95 120ms. pushing logs to s3://redwood-smoke/apac/1753001234/ (link)

tori: warmup job finished 08:40 UTC, 3 hosts warmed, cache hit ratio ~82%.

mike: OK executing step 1 -> 10% now. will post results in ~5m.

alana: thanks. tagging @lucy for ops dashboard watch during the ramp. :thumbsup:

lucy: watching dashboards. alert channels enabled, flapping threshold lowered for duration.

mike: step1 done. initial 5m check: errors 0.25%, p50 token latency +2ms. moving to 30% at 09:22 UTC.

alana: perfect. I'll keep this thread as the single source-of-truth for rollback decisions. If anyone sees unexplained warnings call it out immediately.

jasper: noted — uploaded tail logs and a small grep for WARNING entries. no new warnings so far.

mike: stepping to 30% now.

deploy-bot: Change applied: apac-edge weight -> v2 at 30% by mike at 2025-10-03T09:22:00Z

lucy: 15m into ramp, metrics look stable. continuing to 60% at 09:55 if no regressions.

alana: thanks team. if rollback is needed I’ll initiate and ping SRE channel. otherwise we’ll finish ramp and close thread once at 100%. :party_parrot:
